// ==UserScript==
// @name        Pocket Option OTC AI Candle Scanner (iPhone Safari prototype)
// @namespace   https://github.com/asjadfarooq500-glitch/pocket-option-otc-ai-scanner
// @version     0.1.0
// @description Mobile-first OTC candle analysis userscript. Diagnostic-first: will only show live signals when real OHLC candles are verified on the page. No backend, no paid APIs. For Safari Userscripts extension on iPhone.
// @author      Generated by assistant
// @match       https://*.pocketoption.com/*
// @grant       none
// @run-at      document-start
// ==/UserScript==

(function () {
  'use strict';

  /*************************************************************************
   * Config
   *************************************************************************/
  const DEBUG = false;
  const DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000; // 10s to find live OHLC
  const SIGNAL_COOLDOWN_MS = 1500;

  const TIMEFRAMES = [3,5,15,30,60,120,180,240,300,600,900]; // seconds: 3s - 15m

  // UI colors (dark navy and emerald)
  const UI_COLORS = {
    bg: '#071428', // navy
    accent: '#50c878', // emerald
    text: '#e6f2f1'
  };

  /*************************************************************************
   * Utilities
   *************************************************************************/
  function log(...args){ if(DEBUG) console.log('[PO-OTC-AI]', ...args); }
  function now(){ return Date.now(); }

  /*************************************************************************
   * Diagnostic & Data Capture
   * - Attempts to discover OHLC candles legitimately available to the page
   * - Methods used:
   *   1) look for common global variables (window.candles, window.chartData, etc)
   *   2) monkeypatch WebSocket to inspect messages
   *   3) monkeypatch fetch to inspect JSON responses
   * - Does NOT try to use private endpoints or grab auth tokens
   *************************************************************************/

  let dataVerified = false;
  let discoveredTimeframes = new Set();
  let discoveredPairs = new Set();
  let lastMessage = null;
  let foundOHLCSample = null;

  const probe = {
    startTime: now(),
  };

  function isOHLC(obj){
    if(!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return false;
    // Accept forms like {o:..,h:..,l:..,c:..,t:..} or {open,high,low,close,time}
    const keys = Object.keys(obj).map(k=>k.toLowerCase());
    const hasOHLC = (keys.includes('o') && keys.includes('c')) || (keys.includes('open') && keys.includes('close'));
    const hasHighLow = keys.includes('h') || keys.includes('high');
    const hasTime = keys.includes('t') || keys.includes('time') || keys.includes('timestamp');
    return hasOHLC && hasHighLow && hasTime;
  }

  function extractOHLCFromArray(arr){
    // If arr is array of candle objects
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return null;
    for(const item of arr.slice(0,20)){
      if(isOHLC(item)) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function inspectObject(obj){
    if(!obj) return;
    if(Array.isArray(obj)){
      const sample = extractOHLCFromArray(obj);
      if(sample){
        foundOHLCSample = sample;
        dataVerified = true;
        log('Found OHLC in array sample', sample);
      }
    } else if(isOHLC(obj)){
      foundOHLCSample = obj;
      dataVerified = true;
      log('Found OHLC in object', obj);
    } else if(typeof obj === 'object'){
      // scan nested
      try{
        for(const k in obj){
          if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj,k)) continue;
          const v = obj[k];
          if(isOHLC(v) || (Array.isArray(v) && extractOHLCFromArray(v))){
            const sample = isOHLC(v) ? v : extractOHLCFromArray(v);
            foundOHLCSample = sample;
            dataVerified = true;
            log('Found OHLC nested in key', k, sample);
            break;
          }
        }
      } catch(e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }

  // 1) check common globals
  function checkGlobals(){
    const guesses = ['candles','chartData','chart_candles','ohlc','window.candles','window.chart'];
    for(const name of Object.keys(window)){
      try{
        if(guesses.includes(name.toLowerCase())){
          const v = window[name];
          inspectObject(v);
        }
      } catch(e){}
    }

    // also scan a few common property names
    const props = ['candles','chartData','ohlc','candlesData','candles_list'];
    for(const p of props){
      try{ if(window[p]) inspectObject(window[p]); } catch(e){}
    }
  }

  // 2) monkeypatch WebSocket to inspect messages
  const OriginalWebSocket = window.WebSocket;
  function patchWebSocket(){
    function Wrapped(url, protocols){
      const sock = protocols ? new OriginalWebSocket(url, protocols) : new OriginalWebSocket(url);
      const add = sock.addEventListener.bind(sock);
      const origOn = sock.onmessage;
      sock.addEventListener = function(type, handler){
        if(type === 'message'){
          // wrap handler
          const wrapped = function(e){
            try{ parseMessagePayload(e.data); } catch(e){}
            return handler.call(this,e);
          };
          return add(type, wrapped);
        }
        return add(type, handler);
      };
      Object.defineProperty(sock, 'onmessage', {
        set(fn){
          const wrapped = function(e){ try{ parseMessagePayload(e.data); }catch(e){}; return fn && fn.call(this,e); };
          origOn && Object.defineProperty(sock, 'onmessage', {value: wrapped, configurable:true, writable:true});
          sock.addEventListener('message', wrapped);
        },
        get(){ return origOn; }
      });
      // Also listen at the document level
      sock.addEventListener('message', (e)=>{ try{ parseMessagePayload(e.data); }catch(e){} });
      return sock;
    }
    Wrapped.prototype = OriginalWebSocket.prototype;
    window.WebSocket = Wrapped;
    log('WebSocket patched for diagnostic');
  }

  function tryParseJSON(s){
    try{ return JSON.parse(s); }catch(e){ return null; }
  }

  function parseMessagePayload(data){
    lastMessage = data;
    // Try to parse JSON
    const parsed = (typeof data === 'string') ? tryParseJSON(data) : data;
    if(parsed) inspectObject(parsed);
  }

  // 3) monkeypatch fetch
  const OrigFetch = window.fetch;
  function patchFetch(){
    if(!OrigFetch) return;
    window.fetch = function(resource, init){
      return OrigFetch(resource, init).then(async (resp)=>{
        try{
          const ct = resp.headers.get('content-type') || '';
          if(ct.includes('application/json')){
            const clone = resp.clone();
            const j = await clone.json().catch(()=>null);
            if(j) inspectObject(j);
          }
        } catch(e){}
        return resp;
      });
    };
    log('fetch patched for diagnostic');
  }

  // 4) monkeypatch XHR
  function patchXHR(){
    const OriginalXHR = window.XMLHttpRequest;
    function WrappedXHR(){
      const xhr = new OriginalXHR();
      const origOnReady = xhr.onreadystatechange;
      xhr.addEventListener('readystatechange', function(){
        try{
          if(xhr.readyState === 4){
            const ct = xhr.getResponseHeader && xhr.getResponseHeader('Content-Type');
            if(ct && ct.includes('application/json')){
              try{
                const parsed = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                inspectObject(parsed);
              } catch(e){}
            }
          }
        } catch(e){}
        return origOnReady && origOnReady.apply(this, arguments);
      });
      return xhr;
    }
    WrappedXHR.prototype = OriginalXHR.prototype;
    window.XMLHttpRequest = WrappedXHR;
    log('XHR patched for diagnostic');
  }

  // Run probes
  function startProbes(){
    checkGlobals();
    patchWebSocket();
    patchFetch();
    patchXHR();
  }

  /*************************************************************************
   * Analysis Engine
   *************************************************************************/

  // indicator helpers
  function sma(values, period){
    const out = [];
    let sum = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++){
      sum += values[i];
      if(i>=period) sum -= values[i-period];
      if(i>=period-1) out.push(sum/period);
      else out.push(null);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function ema(values, period){
    const k = 2/(period+1);
    const out = [];
    let prev = null;
    for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++){
      const v = values[i];
      if(i===0){ prev = v; out.push(v); continue; }
      prev = prev === null ? v : (v * k + prev * (1-k));
      out.push(prev);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function rsi(values, period=14){
    const out = [];
    let gains = 0, losses = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++){
      if(i===0){ out.push(null); continue; }
      const change = values[i]-values[i-1];
      gains += Math.max(0,change);
      losses += Math.max(0,-change);
      if(i>period){
        // remove contribution of value i-period
        const prevChange = values[i-period+1]-values[i-period];
        gains -= Math.max(0,prevChange);
        losses -= Math.max(0,-prevChange);
      }
      if(i>=period){
        const avgGain = gains/period;
        const avgLoss = losses/period;
        const rs = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : avgGain/avgLoss;
        const rsi = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : 100 - (100/(1+rs));
        out.push(rsi);
      } else out.push(null);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function macd(values, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9){
    const emaFast = ema(values, fast);
    const emaSlow = ema(values, slow);
    const macdLine = values.map((v,i)=> (emaFast[i]!==null && emaSlow[i]!==null) ? (emaFast[i]-emaSlow[i]) : null);
    const signalLine = ema(macdLine.map(v=>v===null?0:v), signal);
    const hist = macdLine.map((v,i)=> (v===null||signalLine[i]===null) ? null : v - signalLine[i]);
    return {macdLine, signalLine, hist};
  }

  function stoch(highs, lows, closes, kPeriod=14, dPeriod=3){
    const outK = []; const outD = [];
    for(let i=0;i<closes.length;i++){
      if(i<kPeriod-1){ outK.push(null); outD.push(null); continue; }
      let highest = -Infinity; let lowest = Infinity;
      for(let j=i-kPeriod+1;j<=i;j++){ highest = Math.max(highest, highs[j]); lowest = Math.min(lowest, lows[j]); }
      const k = highest===lowest?50:((closes[i]-lowest)/(highest-lowest))*100;
      outK.push(k);
    }
    const d = sma(outK.map(v=>v===null?0:v), dPeriod);
    for(let i=0;i<outK.length;i++) outD.push(d[i]===undefined?null:d[i]);
    return {k: outK, d: outD};
  }

  function bollinger(closes, period=20, mult=2){
    const out = [];
    for(let i=0;i<closes.length;i++){
      if(i<period-1){ out.push({mid:null,upper:null,lower:null}); continue; }
      const slice = closes.slice(i-period+1,i+1);
      const mean = slice.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/period;
      const variance = slice.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-mean)*(b-mean),0)/period;
      const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
      out.push({mid:mean, upper: mean + mult*std, lower: mean - mult*std});
    }
    return out;
  }

  function atr(highs,lows,closes,period=14){
    const out=[]; let prevClose=null;
    for(let i=0;i<closes.length;i++){
      if(i===0){ out.push(null); prevClose=closes[i]; continue; }
      const tr = Math.max(highs[i]-lows[i], Math.abs(highs[i]-prevClose), Math.abs(lows[i]-prevClose));
      if(i<period) out.push(null);
      else if(i===period){ // initial ATR as SMA of TR
        let sum=0; for(let j=1;j<=period;j++){ const pClose = closes[j-1]; const trj = Math.max(highs[j]-lows[j], Math.abs(highs[j]-pClose), Math.abs(lows[j]-pClose)); sum+=trj; }
        out.push(sum/period);
      } else {
        const prev = out[out.length-1];
        out.push(( (prev*(period-1)) + tr )/period);
      }
      prevClose = closes[i];
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ADX implementation (simplified)
  function adx(highs,lows,closes,period=14){
    const pDM = [], nDM = [], trArr = [];
    for(let i=0;i<closes.length;i++){
      if(i===0){ pDM.push(0); nDM.push(0); trArr.push(0); continue; }
      const upMove = highs[i]-highs[i-1];
      const downMove = lows[i-1]-lows[i];
      pDM.push((upMove>downMove && upMove>0)? upMove:0);
      nDM.push((downMove>upMove && downMove>0)? downMove:0);
      const tr = Math.max(highs[i]-lows[i], Math.abs(highs[i]-closes[i-1]), Math.abs(lows[i]-closes[i-1]));
      trArr.push(tr);
    }
    // Smooth with Wilder's
    function smooth(arr){
      const out=[]; let sum=0; for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
        if(i<period){ sum+=arr[i]; out.push(null); }
        else if(i===period){ sum+=arr[i]; out.push(sum); }
        else { sum = sum - (sum/period) + arr[i]; out.push(sum); }
      } return out;
    }
    const sTR = smooth(trArr);
    const sP = smooth(pDM);
    const sN = smooth(nDM);
    const pDI = sTR.map((v,i)=> v? (100*(sP[i]/v)) : null);
    const nDI = sTR.map((v,i)=> v? (100*(sN[i]/v)) : null);
    const dx = pDI.map((p,i)=> (p===null||nDI[i]===null)? null : (100*Math.abs(p-nDI[i])/(p+nDI[i])));
    // ADX is smoothed DX
    const adxOut = []; let prevADX=null;
    for(let i=0;i<dx.length;i++){
      if(i<period*2) adxOut.push(null);
      else if(i===period*2) {
        // initial adx as average of dx over period
        let sum=0; for(let j=i-period+1;j<=i;j++) sum+=dx[j]||0; adxOut.push(sum/period);
      } else {
        const prev = adxOut[adxOut.length-1];
        adxOut.push(((prev*(period-1)) + (dx[i]||0))/period);
      }
    }
    return {pDI,nDI,dx,adx:adxOut};
  }

  /*************************************************************************
   * Candlestick pattern detection (documented patterns)
   *************************************************************************/
  function candleParts(candle){
    // expects object with o,h,l,c,t or open,high,low,close
    const o = candle.o ?? candle.open ?? candle.O ?? candle[0];
    const h = candle.h ?? candle.high ?? candle.H ?? candle[1];
    const l = candle.l ?? candle.low ?? candle.L ?? candle[2];
    const c = candle.c ?? candle.close ?? candle.C ?? candle[3];
    return {o:+o,h:+h,l:+l,c:+c};
  }

  function isBull(c){ return c.c > c.o; }
  function isBear(c){ return c.c < c.o; }

  function detectDoji(c, tolerancePerc=0.1){
    const body = Math.abs(c.c - c.o);
    const range = c.h - c.l;
    return body <= (range * tolerancePerc);
  }

  function detectHammer(c){
    const body = Math.abs(c.c - c.o);
    const lowerWick = Math.min(c.o,c.c) - c.l;
    const upperWick = c.h - Math.max(c.o,c.c);
    return lowerWick >= body*2 && upperWick <= body;
  }

  function detectShootingStar(c){
    const body = Math.abs(c.c - c.o);
    const upperWick = c.h - Math.max(c.o,c.c);
    const lowerWick = Math.min(c.o,c.c) - c.l;
    return upperWick >= body*2 && lowerWick <= body;
  }

  function detectEngulfing(prev,curr){
    const p = prev; const n = curr;
    const pBody = Math.abs(p.c - p.o);
    const nBody = Math.abs(n.c - n.o);
    // bullish engulfing: prev is bear, curr is bull, curr.body covers prev.body
    if(p.c < p.o && n.c > n.o && n.c - n.o > p.o - p.c) return 'bullish';
    if(p.c > p.o && n.c < n.o && n.o - n.c > p.c - p.o) return 'bearish';
    return null;
  }

  function detectInside(prev,curr){
    return curr.h <= prev.h && curr.l >= prev.l;
  }
  function detectOutside(prev,curr){
    return curr.h >= prev.h && curr.l <= prev.l;
  }

  // star patterns simplified
  function detectMorningStar(a,b,c){
    // a: long bear, b: small (doji or small body), c: long bull closing > midpoint of a
    if(a.c >= a.o) return false; if(c.c <= c.o) return false;
    if(!detectDoji(b,0.2) && Math.abs(b.c-b.o) > (Math.abs(a.c-a.o)/2)) return false;
    return c.c > (a.o + a.c)/2;
  }
  function detectEveningStar(a,b,c){
    if(a.c <= a.o) return false; if(c.c >= c.o) return false;
    if(!detectDoji(b,0.2) && Math.abs(b.c-b.o) > (Math.abs(a.c-a.o)/2)) return false;
    return c.c < (a.o + a.c)/2;
  }

  /*************************************************************************
   * Signal generation
   *************************************************************************/
  function generateSignal(candles, tfSeconds){
    // candles: array of objects with o,h,l,c,t in chronological order (old->new)
    if(!candles || candles.length<50) return {signal:'WAIT', reasons:['insufficient history']};
    const closes = candles.map(c=>+c.c);
    const highs = candles.map(c=>+c.h);
    const lows = candles.map(c=>+c.l);
    const opens = candles.map(c=>+c.o);

    const ema9 = ema(closes,9); const ema21 = ema(closes,21); const ema50 = ema(closes,50);
    const rsi14 = rsi(closes,14);
    const mac = macd(closes,12,26,9);
    const boll = bollinger(closes,20,2);

    const last = candleParts(candles[candles.length-1]);
    const prev = candleParts(candles[candles.length-2]);

    const reasons = [];

    // data-quality checks
    // stale-data: check last candle timestamp vs now
    if(candles[candles.length-1].t){
      const ts = +candles[candles.length-1].t;
      const age = Math.abs(Date.now() - ts);
      if(age > Math.max(5*1000, tfSeconds*1000*2)) reasons.push('stale_data');
    }

    // simple trend bias
    const biasBull = ema9[ema9.length-1] > ema21[ema21.length-1] && ema21[ema21.length-1] > ema50[ema50.length-1];
    const biasBear = ema9[ema9.length-1] < ema21[ema21.length-1] && ema21[ema21.length-1] < ema50[ema50.length-1];
    if(biasBull) reasons.push('bullish_ema_stack');
    if(biasBear) reasons.push('bearish_ema_stack');

    // momentum
    const lastRsi = rsi14[rsi14.length-1];
    if(lastRsi !== null){ if(lastRsi>70) reasons.push('rsi_overbought'); if(lastRsi<30) reasons.push('rsi_oversold'); }

    // patterns
    const engulf = detectEngulfing(prev,last);
    if(engulf==='bullish') reasons.push('bullish_engulfing');
    if(engulf==='bearish') reasons.push('bearish_engulfing');
    if(detectDoji(last,0.05)) reasons.push('doji');
    if(detectHammer(last)) reasons.push('hammer');
    if(detectShootingStar(last)) reasons.push('shooting_star');

    // consecutive candles
    let consecBull=0, consecBear=0;
    for(let i=candles.length-1;i>=0 && i>candles.length-11;i--){
      const c = candleParts(candles[i]);
      if(c.c>c.o){ consecBull++; consecBear=0; }
      else if(c.c<c.o){ consecBear++; consecBull=0; }
      else { consecBull=0; consecBear=0; }
    }
    if(consecBull>=3) reasons.push('consecutive_bull_'+consecBull);
    if(consecBear>=3) reasons.push('consecutive_bear_'+consecBear);

    // breakout / retest detection (very simple): last candle breaks above recent high/low
    const recentHigh = Math.max(...highs.slice(-20,-1));
    const recentLow = Math.min(...lows.slice(-20,-1));
    if(last.h > recentHigh && last.c > recentHigh) reasons.push('breakout_up');
    if(last.l < recentLow && last.c < recentLow) reasons.push('breakout_down');

    // Decide signal conservatively
    let signal='WAIT';
    let reasonSummary='';
    if(dataVerified){
      if(biasBull && engulf==='bullish' && lastRsi>50) { signal='CALL'; reasonSummary='EMA stack + bullish engulfing + RSI'; }
      else if(biasBear && engulf==='bearish' && lastRsi<50) { signal='PUT'; reasonSummary='EMA stack + bearish engulfing + RSI'; }
      else if(reasons.includes('breakout_up') && lastRsi>55) { signal='CALL'; reasonSummary='breakout_up + momentum'; }
      else if(reasons.includes('breakout_down') && lastRsi<45) { signal='PUT'; reasonSummary='breakout_down + momentum'; }
      else signal='WAIT';
    } else {
      signal='WAIT'; reasons.push('data_not_verified');
    }

    return {signal, reasons, reasonSummary, metrics:{ema9:ema9[ema9.length-1],ema21:ema21[ema21.length-1],rsi:lastRsi}};
  }

  /*************************************************************************
   * UI
   *************************************************************************/

  function createUI(){
    // create floating panel
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.id='po-otc-ai-panel';
    panel.style.position='fixed';
    panel.style.zIndex=9999999;
    panel.style.right='8px';
    panel.style.top='60px';
    panel.style.width='320px';
    panel.style.maxWidth='92%';
    panel.style.borderRadius='12px';
    panel.style.background=UI_COLORS.bg;
    panel.style.color=UI_COLORS.text;
    panel.style.fontFamily='-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial';
    panel.style.boxShadow='0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    panel.style.padding='8px';

    panel.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px;">
        <div style="font-weight:600">PO OTC AI (prototype)</div>
        <div id="po-status" style="font-size:12px;color:${UI_COLORS.accent}">INIT</div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;">
        <input id="po-pair-search" placeholder="Search pair" style="flex:1;padding:6px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #0b2230;background:#03131a;color:${UI_COLORS.text}" />
        <select id="po-pair-select" style="width:120px;padding:6px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #0b2230;background:#03131a;color:${UI_COLORS.text}"><option value="">pairs</option></select>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;align-items:center;">
        <select id="po-tf-select" style="flex:1;padding:6px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #0b2230;background:#03131a;color:${UI_COLORS.text}"></select>
        <div id="po-countdown" style="min-width:56px;text-align:center;padding:6px;border-radius:6px;background:#03131a">--:--</div>
      </div>
      <div id="po-data-info" style="font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px;color:#a8cfc0">Diagnostic running...</div>
      <div id="po-signal" style="font-weight:700;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px;color:${UI_COLORS.text};text-align:center">WAIT</div>
      <div id="po-reasons" style="font-size:12px;color:#b9e9d0;min-height:24px"></div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;">
        <button id="po-backtest" style="background:${UI_COLORS.accent};color:#042022;padding:6px;border-radius:8px;border:none;flex:1">Backtest</button>
        <button id="po-clear" style="background:#12333a;color:${UI_COLORS.text};padding:6px;border-radius:8px;border:none">Clear</button>
      </div>
      <div id="po-history" style="margin-top:8px;max-height:160px;overflow:auto;font-size:12px;color:#bfe8d9"></div>
    `;

    document.documentElement.appendChild(panel);

    const tfSelect = panel.querySelector('#po-tf-select');
    TIMEFRAMES.forEach(sec=>{
      const opt = document.createElement('option'); opt.value = String(sec); opt.textContent = formatTfLabel(sec); tfSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });

    panel.querySelector('#po-clear').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ localStorage.removeItem('po_otc_history'); renderHistory(); });
    panel.querySelector('#po-backtest').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ runBacktest(); });

    const pairSearch = panel.querySelector('#po-pair-search');
    pairSearch.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const q = pairSearch.value.toLowerCase(); const sel = panel.querySelector('#po-pair-select');
      Array.from(sel.options).forEach(opt=>{ opt.style.display = opt.value && opt.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q)?'block':'none'; });
    });

    return panel;
  }

  function formatTfLabel(sec){
    if(sec<60) return `${sec}s`;
    if(sec%60===0) return `${sec/60}m`;
    return `${Math.floor(sec/60)}m ${sec%60}s`;
  }

  function updateStatus(text, color=UI_COLORS.accent){
    const el = document.getElementById('po-status'); if(el){ el.textContent = text; el.style.color = color; }
  }

  function renderHistory(){
    const container = document.getElementById('po-history'); if(!container) return;
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('po_otc_history');
    const arr = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    if(arr.length===0) { container.innerHTML = '<div style="opacity:0.6">No history</div>'; return; }
    container.innerHTML = arr.slice().reverse().map(it=>`<div style="padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)"><div style="font-weight:600">${it.signal} ${it.pair||''} ${it.tf?sprintfTf(it.tf):''}</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#cfe8d9">${new Date(it.ts).toLocaleString()} — ${it.reason}</div></div>`).join('');
  }

  function sprintfTf(sec){ return formatTfLabel(Number(sec)); }

  function saveSignal(sig){
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('po_otc_history');
    const arr = raw?JSON.parse(raw):[];
    arr.push(sig);
    while(arr.length>1000) arr.shift();
    localStorage.setItem('po_otc_history', JSON.stringify(arr));
    renderHistory();
  }

  /*************************************************************************
   * Backtest (very simple out-of-sample)
   *************************************************************************/
  function runBacktest(){
    updateStatus('Backtesting...', UI_COLORS.accent);
    try{
      const pair = document.getElementById('po-pair-select').value;
      const tf = Number(document.getElementById('po-tf-select').value || 60);
      // load stored sample candles if available
      const raw = window.__po_otc_last_candles__ || null;
      if(!raw || raw.length<100){ updateStatus('No cached candles for backtest', '#f39c12'); return; }
      // simulate signals on sliding window
      const candles = raw.slice();
      let wins=0, losses=0, total=0;
      for(let i=50;i<candles.length-1;i++){
        const slice = candles.slice(0,i+1);
        const res = generateSignal(slice, tf);
        if(res.signal==='WAIT') continue;
        total++;
        // outcome: next candle direction
        const next = slice[slice.length-1]; // current last
        const nextAfter = candles[i+1];
        const winner = (nextAfter.c > next.c) ? 'CALL' : 'PUT';
        if(winner===res.signal) wins++; else losses++;
      }
      updateStatus(`Backtest done: ${wins}/${total} wins`, UI_COLORS.accent);
    } catch(e){ updateStatus('Backtest failed', '#e74c3c'); }
  }

  /*************************************************************************
   * Main orchestration
   *************************************************************************/
  let uiPanel = null;
  let lastSignalTs = 0;
  function start(){
    uiPanel = createUI(); renderHistory();
    updateStatus('DIAG');
    startProbes();

    // after timeout, finalize diagnostic
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(dataVerified){
        updateStatus('DATA OK', UI_COLORS.accent);
        document.getElementById('po-data-info').textContent = 'Real OHLC detected. Signals will be shown.';
        // enable tf options depending on discovered timeframes (not implemented fully - allow all)
      } else {
        updateStatus('DATA OFFLINE', '#ff6b6b');
        document.getElementById('po-data-info').textContent = 'No real OHLC accessible from this page. DATA OFFLINE.';
        document.getElementById('po-signal').textContent='DATA OFFLINE';
        // stop here per project instructions
        log('Data offline — stopping further analysis');
        return;
      }

      // If verified, wire up live updates from intercepted messages
      window.__po_otc_live_handler__ = function(candleArrayOrObj){
        // Accept array of candles or single candle
        let arr = []; if(Array.isArray(candleArrayOrObj)) arr = candleArrayOrObj; else if(candleArrayOrObj && typeof candleArrayOrObj === 'object' && isOHLC(candleArrayOrObj)) arr = [candleArrayOrObj];
        if(arr.length===0) return;
        // normalize to objects with o,h,l,c,t keys
        const normalized = arr.map(a=>{
          const o = a.o ?? a.open ?? a.O ?? a[0];
          const h = a.h ?? a.high ?? a.H ?? a[1];
          const l = a.l ?? a.low ?? a.L ?? a[2];
          const c = a.c ?? a.close ?? a.C ?? a[3];
          const t = a.t ?? a.time ?? a.timestamp ?? (Date.now());
          return {o:+o,h:+h,l:+l,c:+c,t:+t};
        });
        // store last sample globally for backtest
        window.__po_otc_last_candles__ = (window.__po_otc_last_candles__ || []).concat(normalized);
        // keep size manageable
        if(window.__po_otc_last_candles__.length > 2000) window.__po_otc_last_candles__ = window.__po_otc_last_candles__.slice(-2000);

        // pick timeframe from UI
        const tf = Number(document.getElementById('po-tf-select').value || 60);
        const sig = generateSignal(window.__po_otc_last_candles__, tf);
        const sigEl = document.getElementById('po-signal');
        const reasonsEl = document.getElementById('po-reasons');
        if(now() - lastSignalTs < SIGNAL_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
        lastSignalTs = now();
        sigEl.textContent = sig.signal;
        reasonsEl.textContent = sig.reasons.join(', ')+ (sig.reasonSummary?(' — '+sig.reasonSummary):'');
        saveSignal({ts:Date.now(),signal:sig.signal,reason:sig.reasons.join(';'),pair:document.getElementById('po-pair-select').value,tf:tf});

      };

      // try to populate pairs from DOM if available; otherwise keep empty
      tryPopulatePairs();

      updateStatus('LIVE', UI_COLORS.accent);
    }, DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT_MS);

    // fill tf default
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ const sel=document.getElementById('po-tf-select'); sel.value='60'; });
  }

  function tryPopulatePairs(){
    // attempt to find pair list in page: many trading UIs render pair names in elements with data-asset or .asset-name
    const sel = document.getElementById('po-pair-select');
    const found = new Set();
    const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('[data-asset], .asset-name, .pair-name, .instrument-name');
    nodes.forEach(n=>{ const text = n.getAttribute('data-asset') || n.textContent || n.innerText; if(text){ const val = text.trim(); if(val) found.add(val); } });
    if(found.size>0){
      sel.innerHTML=''; found.forEach(v=>{ const o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=v; o.textContent=v; sel.appendChild(o); });
      document.getElementById('po-data-info').textContent += ` Pairs populated: ${found.size}`;
    } else {
      // leave blank and inform
      document.getElementById('po-data-info').textContent += ' No pair list found on page.';
    }
  }

  // Start after DOM ready
  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();

  // expose some debug hooks
  window.__po_otc_debug__ = {get lastMessage(){return lastMessage;}, get foundSample(){return foundOHLCSample;}, get dataVerified(){return dataVerified}};

})();
